revision: HUBB sharing story, open cartons, silent scroll ritual and price-free B2B

motion.engine: Native CSS, IntersectionObserver, event-driven requestAnimationFrame schedulers for scenes and ritual
motion.intent: Follow four everyday Saudi sharing stories without replacing ordinary document scrolling
motion.signature: Desktop sticky image crossfades as the nearest chapter becomes active; vertical image drift limited to14px
motion.mobile: At760px and below, unpin images and show one image with each chapter; no product hover movement
motion.reduced_motion: No entrance, reveal, image drift or crossfade. Each image and its story remain visible in a static grid or mobile stack.
motion.without_javascript: Each scene is visible inline; no content relies on motion for comprehension.
motion.performance_evidence: Inspected native event-driven scheduling and bounds. Desktop and mobile layouts observed in browser. CPU-throttled frame rate and physical-device GPU performance were not measured.
motion.ritual: Seven object layers: two clipped outer shell faces, two empty inner husks, edible kernel, bag back and occluding bag front. Transform/opacity follow normalized native scroll. No audio APIs or click-to-advance.
motion.ritual_mobile: Sticky 46svh artwork with four flowing text chapters. Height480px or below, reduced motion and no JavaScript show a static exploded guide.

assets.cartons: Four open counter-display carton assets using owner reference for structure only; current HUBB artwork preserved
assets.lifestyle: Four original AI-generated2:3 portrait concepts; labelled as concepts in the page
assets.ritual: Four generated alpha cutouts; original PNGs and WebP copies in assets/ritual-*-v4; prompts in assets/RITUAL_V4_PROMPTS.md

content: Consumer happiness and sharing lead. Two years of care appear under About HUBB. No market-superiority, award, certification, fabricated-customer-review or real-endorsement claims.
commerce: B2B quantity/count/weight only; visitor prepares price-free enquiry asking team for offers, availability and delivery/supply terms.
